attributes.title: Crossing
attributes.lede: Two skins cross inside one flying box. The video never stops.

lesson.concept: The interior can stay live during a transformation
lesson.why: Crossing blends two skins inside a moving box while unregistered video, scrolling content and animated marks continue to run. This tests continuity that a still image cannot demonstrate.
lesson.experiment: Watch the moving mark and scroll the pane while the container crosses. Compare the internal motion before, during and after the transition.
lesson.pitfall: View-transition snapshots freeze live descendants for the snapshot's duration.
lesson.combine: Combine with inline editing when a read view changes into an interactive form without losing continuity.
